about.title: About Titan Industrial Storage
text: Over forty years storing industrial equipment near the Houston Ship Channel — the kind that is expensive, awkward, and cannot be replaced on a short lead time.

Titan Industrial Storage operates from two sites in Pasadena, Texas — ten warehouses between them. Indoor warehousing, climate and humidity controlled storage, twelve acres of stabilized yard, and the equipment and people to load and unload it all.

Our customers are refineries, oilfield service companies, aerospace and defense suppliers, wind and renewable energy operators, plastics processors and heavy manufacturers. What they have in common is not an industry. It is that the thing they need stored is worth more than the storage, and getting it wrong is expensive.
